name: io.github.opsconduit/jobber-mcp
title: OpsConduit Jobber MCP
description: Customer-hosted read-only MCP server for Jobber ops reports, OAuth setup, and GraphQL validation.

environmentVariables.name: JOBBER_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Jobber developer app client id for customer-owned OAuth setup.

environmentVariables.name: JOBBER_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Jobber developer app client secret. Keep local; do not email or publish.

environmentVariables.name: JOBBER_REDIRECT_URI
environmentVariables.description: OAuth redirect URI, usually http://localhost:3333/oauth/callback for local setup.

tools.name: jobber_auth_url
tools.description: Create the one-time Jobber OAuth authorization link for a customer-hosted install and return the state value to verify after redirect.

tools.name: jobber_exchange_code
tools.description: Exchange the Jobber OAuth authorization code copied from the customer's redirect URL and store tokens on the local machine without exposing them in chat.

tools.name: jobber_refresh_token
tools.description: Refresh the locally stored Jobber access token so read-only reporting queries can continue without exposing token values.

tools.name: jobber_account
tools.description: Validate the connected Jobber account id and name before any operational read queries are run.

tools.name: jobber_clients_sample
tools.description: Read a capped sample of Jobber clients to confirm GraphQL read access and pagination behavior during install validation.

tools.name: jobber_graphql_read
tools.description: Run a read-only Jobber GraphQL query for operations reporting, with mutation operations blocked before the request is sent.
